featured_reviews.name: desifoodiegirl Purnima
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of organizing a special event at Shub Banquet Hall in Vasai, and I must say it was an absolutely delightful experience from start to finish. The venue exceeded all my expectations and left a lasting impression on me and my guests.

Firstly, I would like to commend the staff at Shub Banquet Hall for their exceptional service. From the very first inquiry to the day of the event, their professionalism, attention to detail, and friendly demeanor were truly remarkable. They were extremely responsive, patiently addressing all my queries and offering valuable suggestions to make my event a grand success.

The banquet hall itself is simply stunning. The ambiance is elegant, and the décor is tastefully done, creating a beautiful and inviting atmosphere. The hall is spacious, allowing ample room for guests to move around comfortably. The seating arrangement was well-planned, and the lighting added a touch of sophistication to the entire setup.

One of the standout aspects of Shub Banquet Hall is their catering service. The food provided was exquisite and delectable. From the appetizers to the main course and desserts, every dish was prepared to perfection. The presentation was impeccable, and the flavors were simply outstanding. The menu options were diverse, catering to different tastes and dietary preferences.

Additionally, the facilities provided by Shub Banquet Hall were top-notch. The sound system and audiovisual equipment were of excellent quality, ensuring smooth communication and entertainment throughout the event. The staff was readily available to assist with any technical requirements, making sure everything ran seamlessly.

Lastly, I want to express my gratitude for the overall management and coordination. The team at Shub Banquet Hall demonstrated great professionalism in handling all the arrangements, ensuring that every aspect of my event was taken care of. Their expertise and efficiency were evident, resulting in a stress-free and enjoyable experience for me and my guests.

In conclusion, I highly recommend Shub Banquet Hall in Vasai for any special event or celebration. The combination of exceptional service, beautiful ambiance, delicious food, and remarkable facilities truly sets them apart. My experience at Shub Banquet Hall was nothing short of amazing, and I look forward to hosting many more events at this fantastic venue in the future.

Note: This review is based on my personal experience at Shub Banquet Hall as of my visit in 2023.

featured_reviews.name: Roland Rebeiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to formally express my deep dissatisfaction with the experience at Dream Arena during a christening celebration we recently attended as guests.

Unfortunately, the event was marred by several issues. The air conditioning was not functioning properly despite the intense summer heat, with the temperature set at 31°C. Instead of resolving the problem, a few ineffective fans were provided, which guests had to manage themselves, causing significant discomfort.

Additionally, the service was extremely poor. Guests had arrived at 11:00 AM, but starters were served only around 2:00 PM. Even then, the portions were minimal and insufficient. The quality of the food was also below expectations and appeared stale.

What was most disappointing was the attitude of the staff, who were rude, unhelpful, and insensitive to the needs of guests on such an important family occasion.

This experience caused unnecessary stress and discomfort for everyone involved. I strongly urge the management to take this feedback seriously and improve both service quality and guest handling.

I hope appropriate action will be taken to ensure such incidents do not occur in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Mountainbachha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently hosted an event at Regency Banquet and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The staff deserves special appreciation — they were extremely polite, attentive, and well-coordinated throughout the function. From the planning stage to the final wrap-up, everything was handled smoothly and professionally, which made the entire experience stress-free for us.
The food was truly outstanding. Every dish was fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Our guests kept complimenting the taste and variety, which says a lot about the quality of their catering. It’s rare to find food that pleases people of all age groups, but Regency managed to do just that.
The ambiance of the banquet hall is another highlight. The decor is elegant yet warm, creating a very comforting and welcoming vibe. The lighting, cleanliness, and overall setup added a touch of class without feeling over the top.
Overall, Regency Banquet exceeded our expectations in every way — excellent service, delicious food, and a lovely atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a memorable and hassle-free event. Definitely a 5-star experience!

featured_reviews.name: SANJIV RAI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good place for small wedding, it can not handle anywhere more than 150 guests. There is no dedicated parking. Staff is good at reception till their work timing, no assistance post that.
Food was good but we did lot of tasting and menu fixing to make sure it was good.
There were powercuts and generator is slow to load and ends quickly. Power backup needs to be fixed.

Decoration was not upto the point and if late night wedding then tea and other service is negligible.

Cleaning crew is also questionable and washrooms are difficult to navigate and not so clean.

Overall good for small functions.

featured_reviews.name: Roshan Hegde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Regency Banquet Hall holds some of the most beautiful memories of my life. I have celebrated multiple functions here — from my personal engagement and mehndi to today’s very special occasion, my wife’s baby shower. Every single event has been flawlessly executed.
The entire management team is outstanding. Their food has never failed to impress me, my family, or my friends — consistently delicious and honestly at par with an à la carte experience. Quality, taste, and presentation have always been top-notch.
A special kudos to Shashidhar Shetty and his team for running such a wonderful chain with professionalism, warmth, and attention to detail. Regency Banquet Hall will always be my first choice for celebrations and a place I recommend wholeheartedly.

featured_reviews.name: Mrunali Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: Staff is polite. Food quality is average. Starters were good, since they are not very spicy even kids can enjoy eating starters.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Rawat
featured_reviews.review_text: This venue is great for weddings and parties, but there's room for improvement. The bathrooms need to be cleaner, and the logic behind locating the ladies' bathroom on the third floor and the gents' on the second floor is puzzling. The ambiance and food are good, but the service needs about 30% improvement. I appreciate the security measure of asking for a wedding card for entry, but it would be helpful if the venue clearly indicated which floor is which to avoid confusion. Overall, it's an okay location, but some tweaks are necessary."

featured_reviews.review_text: I got married in 2023 Feb 12. My marriage was a disaster here. Literally their service was so poor that no arrangements were done when the guests arrived. featured_reviews.name: Viran Lilakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Scam!!!

At the time of initial booking, they will take advance and give you assurance you can bring your own catering.

When your event is very near and you have made your catering arrangements, you will get a call to discuss further, where he will put many conditions like you have to use their vessels for which you have to pay 9000 Rupees... How can a catering person use his vessels to cook as he is running his own setup. Upon negotiating he will straight forward say take away your advance money. Since everything is planned, your invitations are sent out and you have only 15 days left for your event you have no option and to agree with his conditions. Later after negotiation it was settled to 4500 Rupees for not using their vessels and then came renting the tables which also had to be taken for them for which I had to pay 1500 Rupees additional.

Would request everyone to be very careful while dealing there as terms & conditions are written in Gujarati which you might not be well versed with.

For everything bring in Sanstha, which has laid down the rule, but while making payment they won't accept cheques as they will say this needs to be given to different people making arrangements here and ask only for cash.
